'''''Koh-Lanta: Caramoan''''' is the eighth season of ''[[Koh-Lanta]]''. It was broadcast on TF1 from July 4 to September 20, 2008, with each episode airing at 8:55&nbsp;p.m.

[[Christelle Gauzet]] defeated [[Frédéric Favier]] in a 6-1 [[jury]] vote to become the [[Sole Survivor]].

== Production ==
This season was filmed in the Caramoan peninsula, located in the Philippines.

==Twists==
* '''[[Tribe|Tribes]] Determined by Challenge:''' On Day 1, the castaways were divided into four groups of four (each containing two men and two women), and would compete in a [[Reward Challenge]] for a 5&nbsp;kg bag of rice. The winning group would choose members from the other three groups to form one of the two tribes.
* '''Replacements:''' Due to two [[evacuation]]s and a [[quit]], two castaways ([[Irya Cissé]] and [[Hakim Djellali]]) returned to the game after being voted out, and one new castaway ([[Alain Garcia]]) entered the game on Day 7.

==Trivia==

* ''Caramoan'' is the third consecutive season of ''Koh-Lanta'' whose final five all belonged to the same starting tribe, following ''[[Koh-Lanta: Vanuatu|Vanuatu]]'' and ''[[Koh-Lanta: Palawan|Palawan]]''.
